children: Portugal's monthly unemployment rate was 5.7% in July, unchanged from June's revised figure and slightly lower than the 5.8% registered a year ago, the National Statistics Institute (INE) said in its flash estimate on Monday.
The labour underutilisation rate stood at 9.5%, up from the 9.3% posted in the previous month.
The youth unemployment rate encompassing 16- to 24-year-olds was 20.1% in July, above June's revised 19.9%, and above the revised 19.5% registered a year ago, the INE added.
